Coram : BHUSHAN RAMKRISHNA GAVAI*, K.V. VISWANATHAN
Issue for Consideration Access to free and timely legal aid for prison inmates. Headnotes† Free Legal Aid – Constitutional and Statutory Framework – Constitution of India – Articles 21, 39-A – Equal justice and free legal aid – Legal Services Authorities Act, by NALSA for making legal services available, creating awareness about convict’s right of appeal, availability of free legal services – Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) by NALSA on Access to Legal Aid Services to Prisoners and Functioning of the Prison Legal Aid Clinics 2022
Decision Date : 23-10-2024 | Case No : WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) No. 1082/2020 | Disposal Nature : Directions issued | Bench : 2 Judges
